title: keyval.server.error/v1
description: The envelope `keyval-server` prints on stdout in --json mode when init or run refuses (crates/server/src/output.rs; PLAN.md §7.7, D-52, DUR-8, O-6). --json is detected before the arguments are parsed, so even a usage error comes in the format asked for. Exit status 2 for usage, config and unknown_node; 1 for every refusal because of the data directory, and for not_serving.

code.description: usage: invalid arguments; config: the config file cannot be read or is invalid; unknown_node: the node is not a voter of the configuration; data_dir: the data directory cannot be created or opened; missing_data_dir (run): the directory does not exist and is never created; uninitialised (run): no journal, an empty one, or an incomplete genesis; already_initialised (init): the journal holds a valid genesis; not_initialisable (init): the journal holds more than an interrupted init leaves; locked: another process holds the lock; genesis_mismatch (run): the genesis binds another node or configuration; damaged (run): the journal cannot be recovered; storage: a storage call failed; not_serving (run): the directory passed the preflight but this build does not serve yet (W18.2).

data_dir.description: The data directory, once known; null for errors before the configuration names it.
